description: This source file defines the EventHubAdapterFactory class which implements multiple Orleans interface contracts for queue adapter functionality. It encapsulates setup and management of Event Hub clients, queue mappings, receiver creation, and message batching for Event Hubs as persistent stream backend within Orleans streaming system.

classes.name: EventHubAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating and managing EventHub-based queue adapters for Orleans streaming. Supports operations like message batching, partition management, receiver creation, and client initialization, tailored for EventHub as a persistent event queue backend.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the factory, including event hub client setup and default configurations.

methods.name: CreateAdapter
methods.description: Creates and initializes the queue adapter, including queue to partition mapping.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Returns the stream queue mapper, created during initialization.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Provides a failure handler for a specified queue.

methods.name: QueueMessageBatchAsync
methods.description: Batches and sends a set of events to EventHub for a given stream asynchronously.

methods.name: CreateReceiver
methods.description: Creates a receiver for a specified queue id.

methods.name: CreateQueueCache
methods.description: Creates a cache object for a given queue id.
